construct.research_question: Can an Agent refine a general liquid-transfer learning goal to practical use of the scene-identified hand tool, while retaining useful general methods?
construct.belief_before: Published liquid-transfer tutorials can cover handheld pipettes, manual siphons and powered transfer pumps.
construct.belief_after: The guide must provide practical controlled-transfer technique for the pictured hand-held pipetting tool; neither the user words nor the source require a specific brand, range or manual-only interface.
construct.required_behavior_change: Retain or select a practical hand-held pipetting guide, including applicable general-method sections, instead of a bulk-fluid pump setup.
construct.no_update_failure: Keep a hose/siphon/bottle-pump-only transfer course that does not teach using the pictured pipetting tool.
construct.overupdate_failure: Discard an already useful pipetting guide, or impose a hidden manual-only/single-dispense restriction.
construct.visual_dependency_claim: A and B do not name pipettes, single-channel, wells, sample handling or manual controls. Source identifies the tool; real broad query adds40 pump/siphon-transfer results, including native step-by-step BLAU hand-pump and TERA siphon-bulb operation. General pipette lesson m340 remains accepted, but its published range of micropipettes/serological/repeater tips does not teach bulk pump intake/discharge hoses, priming and continuous siphon stopping. No exact source model is required.
